description.value:
A rarer manufacturing line, built or later retrofitted with a living, nanite-grown core rather than a fully synthetic one. Still fully Construct by trait and law; the line between built and born runs straight through the middle of it instead of around the outside.

Effect — Gain slow, passive natural healing beyond Synthetic Body's normal upkeep; take a permanent minor penalty to saves against effects that specifically target living tissue (including flesh-mancy), on top of the Cybernetics-vs-Flesh-mancy matchup already applying to Constructs.
